Trial 2026-10-26 (Claude Code 2.1.310, --plugin-dir, disposable projects): a hookify block rule stopped a Bash command, Apex still refused an out-of-scope write, and an in-scope edit finished with both Stop hooks active. The model sees only 'Blocked by hook'; the rule's message reaches the user as a notice. Stays unverified until installed.
